newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN JUNE AIRFREIGHT EXPORTS UP 10 PCT, UP 7.3PCT.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN JUNE AIRFREIGHT EXPORTS UP 10 PCT, UP 7.3PCT.

text.p: The German flown air cargo exports showed a strong 10 percent rise in June and ended the first half-year with 7.3 percent growth, figures from the German airports association ADV showed.
Overall flown air cargo grew 8.5 percent in June and by 6.5 percent in the first half of 1997, the monthly ADV traffic report showed.
Imports increased 6.7 percent in June and 5.2 percent in the January-June period, it added.
Strong double-figure growth was shown by Cologne, Munich, Nuremberg and Stuttgart airports in June.
